title: Injectivity of Boolean duality
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer. For Boolean functions $f,g\colon\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, if $-f(-x)=-g(-x)$ for every $x\in\{\pm1\}^n$, then $f(x)=g(x)$ for every such $x$, where $-x$ denotes coordinatewise negation.
hypotheses_covered: Two functions from the n-dimensional sign cube to the sign set
